_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Empyrion: Galactic Survival egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Empyrion: Galactic Survival
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The space sandbox of ships, bases and planets to survive on. Installs the Windows dedicated server with SteamCMD, runs it under Wine and keeps it updated.
startup: mkdir -p Logs; rm -f Logs/raptor.log; (exec tail -n +1 -F Logs/raptor.log 2>/dev/null) & (until (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/{{TELNET_PORT}}) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done; { printf "%s\n" "$TELNET_PASSWORD"; exec cat; } | exec telnet 127.0.0.1 {{TELNET_PORT}}) <&0 & cd DedicatedServer && wine EmpyrionDedicated.exe -batchmode -nographics -dedicated dedicated.yaml -logFile ../Logs/raptor.log; r=$?; sleep 1; exit $r

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Empyrion: Galactic Survival. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 530870) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously (the Windows version, run under Wine).
# Saves, scenarios and dedicated.yaml are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-530870}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

echo "Installed Empyrion: Galactic Survival build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The server's description in the list, where [b]bold[/b] and [url=...]links[/url] work.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: List the server in the server browser (true or false); otherwise players join by address.

variables.name: Save name
variables.description: The save game to load, or create when there's none by that name.

variables.name: Game mode
variables.description: Survival or Creative, for a new save.

variables.name: Seed
variables.description: The seed a new save's galaxy is made from; the same seed makes the same galaxy.

variables.name: Scenario
variables.description: The scenario a new save uses, by its folder name in Content/Scenarios.

variables.name: EasyAntiCheat
variables.description: Run EasyAntiCheat, which every player then needs (true or false).

variables.name: Allowed blueprints
variables.description: All, StockOnly (only the game's own) or None (no blueprints).

variables.name: Max blueprint size
variables.description: The largest blueprint size class players may build or spawn; 1 allows only small ones.

variables.name: Heartbeat timeout
variables.description: Seconds without a heartbeat before a playfield server is restarted, dropping its players; 0 turns it off.

variables.name: Playfield boot timeout
variables.description: Seconds a playfield server may take to start before it's stopped; 0 turns it off.

variables.name: Console port
variables.description: The server's telnet console port, which the console uses inside the server; don't give it an allocation.

variables.name: Console password
variables.description: The password of the telnet console, which the console signs in with; at least 8 letters, digits or ._- characters.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Windows install
variables.description: Install the Windows version of the server, which runs under Wine.

variables.name: Wine debug
variables.description: What Wine logs; -all keeps its messages out of the console.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
